item.annihilationblade.desc.line1: §8"§dWhen the stars fall silent, this blade still hums in the void.§8"
item.annihilationblade.desc.line2: §8"§5It does not cut flesh; it erases existence's permission to remain.§8"
item.annihilationblade.desc.line3: §8"§dSevered space, wounded worlds, and the last refrain of the end.§8"
item.annihilationblade.desc.line4: §8"§6The wielder needs no victory; the conclusion kneels first.§8"
item.annihilationblade.annihilation_core: §dRight-click to awaken the blade of terminus
item.annihilationblade.annihilation_frag: §7Nine starfall remnants converge into the §5Annihilation Core
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.annihil: Annihilation Blade is a named blade built around terminus execution, rift chaining, and large-scale visual impact. Spatial Fracture opens the battlefield, while Severed Space, World Rift, Terminus Echo, Void Dominion, Causality Collapse, and Phantom Judgement pull enemy groups layer by layer into the end. It favors area suppression, chained clearing, and strong combat feedback.
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.blood_p: Demonic Blade: Blood Prison is a named blade built around health risk, a blood-red domain, and phantom pursuit. Infernal Slaughter opens the domain and blinks through targets, Blood Leech sustains the wielder, Spirit Shield protects the danger window, and Phantom Mark converts repeated hits into burst damage. Compared with Annihilation Blade, it leans harder into close-range pressure.
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.infinit: §b§lInfinity Stellaris§r§7 is forged via a terminus ritual from four Annihilation Cores, a Dragon Egg, two Beacons, a Nether Star, and a Demonic Blade: Blood Prison (5000 kills, 25000 proud soul, 50 refine). Carrying it grants shared flight, invulnerability, dimension-safe void rescue, and adaptive fullbright; all four SEs (§bEntropy Dissolution§7 / §bCosmic String Cut§7 / §dGamma Thunderburst§7 / §bCurvature Rupture§7) and SA (§bVacuum Decay Collapse§7) are independently transplantable and preserve Boss death sequences.§r
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.nightfa: Nightfall Dragon is a three-form demonic-dragon named blade. Z cycles Sealed, Awakened, and Final. Sealed form has Nightfall Judgement Cut: it scans legal targets within 20 blocks and spawns one Judgement Cut every 5 ticks at target feet or random fallback points until 20 cuts appear. Awakened form has Scale Guard: 16 upright phantom blades orbit, expand, pause, rise, and slam down, dealing touch damage during flight and 500% blade panel damage plus 10% max-health damage on impact with camera shake. Final form in inventory grants god-body survival and flight; held final form keeps slash_art as slashblade:none, inherits non-duplicate Demonic Blood and Dragon Pressure traits, and adds Creation God Body, Domain of Absolute Annihilation, Myriad Dragon Blade Storm, and World-Cleaving Slash. Lower companion-sword patterns are replaced by the final blade storm and piercing blade wave, with final-form visual particles capped at 500 per level tick.
jei.annihilationblade.blade_desc.loli_bl: Loli Blade inherits the high-pressure authority of the original Loli Pickaxe: direct main-hand hits execute legal targets on the server; the 48-block cone execution is now a native slash SE, while the 128-block area execution is now a native SA with a success sound. It no longer intercepts left-click empty or sneaking right-click. Holders receive damage interception, full-health recovery, saturation, flight, and void protection by default. All effects stay inside Minecraft server logic and exclude blue screens, client crashes, forced client exits, and system-level operations.
slash_art.annihilationblade.spatial_frac: Unfolds dual vertical arcane seals sequentially in front of the caster, spins them to charge, and fires a piercing void beam at the aimed anchor; on impact, it shatters space with 3D cuts, collapses into a singularity, and detonates in a dazzling supernova screen-cleaving blast with terminus judgement. Range, target cap, fracture slash count, and visual scale are configurable.
slash_art.annihilationblade.nightfall_ju: Scans legal targets within 20 blocks around the wielder, then spawns one Judgement Cut every 5 ticks at target feet or random fallback points until 20 cuts have appeared.
Awakened form releases 16 upright phantom dragon blades around the wielder. They accelerate for 2 seconds, stop sharply, move 5 blocks outward, pause for 10 ticks, then rise and slam down. Touching a flying blade deals 12 damage every 5 ticks; the slam deals 500% blade panel damage plus 10% target max health and shakes the camera.
slash_art.annihilationblade.cosmic_night: §7Unleashes the ultimate cataclysm of Nightfall Dragon: Locks a focal point up to 120 blocks away, pulls targets within 72 blocks into a massive gravity vortex, bombards the battlefield with 15 wide-area meteor waves, then triggers a 72-block core collapse shockwave with 24 purple lightning strikes that strip absorption shields and execute targets below 50% HP.§r
slash_art.annihilationblade.infernal_sla: Channels Demonic Blade: Blood Prison into an infernal domain. Slashes inside the domain blink through hostile targets while the client receives the blood overlay and pressure-heavy particle show. Duration, radius, particle interval, and visual scale are configurable.
slash_art.annihilationblade.vacuum_decay: §7Anchors a §f64-block§7 radius Vacuum Decay domain within §b160 blocks§7 for §f9.2s§7: gravity lift, 14-wave Seven-Star volley, critical pinch, 5-tick dead-silence breath, and synchronized heat-death reckoning (preserves drops by default).§r
slash_art.annihilationblade.loli_area_ex: §7Recasts the Loli Blade area execution as a §dSlashBlade-native SA§7: scans legal targets within §d128 blocks§7, executes them on the server, and plays the §dLoli success§7 sound. It no longer intercepts sneaking right-click.§r
se.annihilationblade.loli_facing_executi: §7Triggers from a §dSlashBlade-native slash SE§7, scanning a §d48-block§7 forward cone for legal targets and executing them on the server. It no longer intercepts left-click empty input.§r
se.annihilationblade.dankong.desc: Locks hostile targets in range, blinks through them in sequence, leaves terminus cuts behind, then returns to the origin. Hold Shift to interrupt; Left Ctrl toggles blink mode while holding any SlashBlade with the Severed Space SE.
se.annihilationblade.world_rift.desc: Dual-mode spatial vortex execution: while Severed Space is disabled (config off, holding Shift, or Left Ctrl blink off), hits suspend and spiral-warp the live target before snapping them into a black singularity and single-chain hopping to the nearest enemy; while Severed Space is enabled, finishing its sheathing screen-slice triggers a linked multi-vortex implosion that twists all severed remains into singularities. Radius, chain count, cooldown, linkage toggle, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.terminus_echo.desc: Absolute Aegis counter-reprisal SE: when attacked or struck by hostile projectiles while armed, unfolds an obsidian-gold deflection mirror to devour the strike and projectile, fires an arcing causal trace to lock and briefly suspend the attacker (tracking even across teleports), and manifests a black-gold phantom of the wielder behind them for a lethal silent execution slash. Held requirement, projectile interception, environment deflect ripple, range, concurrent cap, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.void_dominion.desc: Press Left + Right click together (with a 2-tick chord buffer) to anchor at the aimed terrain and unfold through dimensional reduction, target cataloging, a spherical erasure sweep, singularity collapse, and reality restoration. Targets are executed as the wave reaches them. Empty swings do not trigger it. Range, target cap, chord window, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
World-Rift-kin spacetime rift SE: collapses seamlessly at each slain target's exact position after World Rift executions; standalone right-click slashes follow a three-tier anchor system — vanilla Shift lock-on for 64-block remote sniping (while Shift pauses Severed Space), 24-block free crosshair smart lock-on with 3-point visual line-of-sight anti-occlusion, and smart surface-aware air slashing when aiming away (up to 14 blocks onto ground/walls along surface normals, or 8.5 blocks into open sky). Each lingering (~3.2s) rift pulls nearby hostile mobs into its void horizon and crushes them in a tidal slit execution.
se.annihilationblade.phantom_judgement.d: Left-click shatters blade intent into obsidian-prism master shards that split mid-flight into frost-cyan sub-shards and violet tracker shards, schooling along organic curves to trap targets in a tri-tilted blade cage before detonating into crisscrossing 3D slash strings and screen-slicing execution, then recalling all shards back to the blade. Master/sub/tracker shard counts, total shard cap, slash-string density, cooldown, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.blood_leech.desc: A core Blood Prison passive. Hostile hits turn the wielder's health into both risk and leverage, trading high-pressure melee for lifesteal sustain. Lifesteal and damage logic are fixed.
se.annihilationblade.spirit_shield.desc: Blood Prison's emergency safeguard. When health falls too low, it unfolds a spirit shield and short buffs to stabilize the wielder. Shield safety logic is fixed.
se.annihilationblade.phantom_mark.desc: Blood Prison's hunting mark. Repeated hits stack phantom marks; when they burst, phantom blades tear into the target. Burst sword count, delay, visual radius, and visual scale are configurable.
se.annihilationblade.entropy_dissolution: §7Every valid attack strips an extra §b10% max health§7 and stacks Entropy Marks (fed by co-mounted String Cut, Gamma Burst, and Curvature Rupture); full marks trigger §fHeat Death§7 execution while preserving Ender Dragon and Boss death sequences.§r
se.annihilationblade.curvature_rupture.d: §7Disabled by default; toggle authoritatively with §b I §7. Suppresses legal targets within §b22 blocks§7 and builds Curvature Strain; full marks trigger §dMetric Collapse§7 (strips buffs/absorption, clears i-frames, inward pinch + heavy shock damage and §b2 Entropy Marks§7). AI safely restores on exit or unequip.§r
§7Valid hits call down a §dGamma Orbital Cannon§7: after a §f12-tick§7 warning, an i-frame-piercing §b5.5-block§7 gamma beam strikes for §f18 ticks§7 and applies §b2 Entropy Marks§7.§r
se.annihilationblade.cosmic_string_cut.d: §7Slashing weaves a §b32-block§7 (§f64-block§7 sneaking) cosmic string web binding up to §f10§7 legal targets for §f9 ticks§7 before plucking for heavy damage and §b1 Entropy Mark§7.§r
se.annihilationblade.demonic_blood_paras: Valid hits and Nightfall summoned swords, excluding Outer God Scar, Reverse Scale Hunt, and final-form Dragon Blade swords, stack unbounded Demonic Blood, apply Wither up to V and Blindness, add 5% max-health magic damage, and turn marked follow-up hits into true damage; every 20 Abyssal Flame marks call a falling phantom-sword burst.
se.annihilationblade.outer_god_scar.desc: Sealed-form slashes create purple void scars and companion summoned swords that dance around the wielder before hunting legal targets.
se.annihilationblade.dragon_pressure_dom: Awakened form grants Speed III, Strength III, Night Vision III, and Absorption III while held. Final form inherits Speed, Strength, and Night Vision, while Creation Dragon Shield replaces the lower absorption layer.
Awakened slashes release gold-and-purple reverse-scale swords with stronger speed and pierce, while Dragon Scale Shelter grants Resistance III.
se.annihilationblade.dragon_god_body.des: Final form in inventory grants death-lock protection, harmful-effect cleansing, void fallback, flight, law reflection, lifesteal, Creation Dragon Shield capped at 200 health, and heavily reduced god-body aura particles.
se.annihilationblade.absolute_annihilati: Final form unfolds a throttled 64-block dragon domain every second, stripping buffs and absorption from legal targets, freezing them, dealing 25% current-health magic damage plus fixed true pressure, and executing targets below half health.
se.annihilationblade.myriad_dragon_blade: Final slashes summon twenty dark-gold and star-violet dragon blades that hunt legal targets up to 96 blocks away.
se.annihilationblade.world_cleaving_slas: Final normal slashes add a 72-block wide void blade wave that pulls legal enemies into the scar, suppresses attacks, delivers overwhelming magic damage, and calls up to 16 purple Gamma thunderbolts.
message.annihilationblade.loli_blade.kic: Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆  You were kicked flying by a loli!!!
config.annihilationblade.title: Annihilation Blade Configuration
config.annihilationblade.common.title: Common / Server Configuration
config.annihilationblade.client.title: Client Configuration
config.annihilationblade.clear_inventory: Clear target player's inventory and ender chest
config.annihilationblade.remove_entity: Force-remove entity if normal death does not remove it
config.annihilationblade.clear_inventory: Clears the target player's inventory, equipment, offhand, and ender chest before execution. Disabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.kick_player.too: Disconnects the target player from the server after execution. Disabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.force_death.too: When Loli Blade execution damage does not kill the target, continue with setHealth(0) and die() as a forced-death fallback. Enabled by default; when disabled, only the vanilla damage chain is used.
config.annihilationblade.remove_entity.t: Calls entity removal only when the normal death flow leaves the target alive. Disabled by default.
Enables direct execution, Loli Blade SE cone execution, and Loli Blade SA area execution. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.ultimate_oblite: When enabled, Loli Blade execution uses unblockable physical obliteration: targets are forcefully killed across all 5 health mechanisms regardless of immunity, creative mode, shields, i-frames, or totems. Non-player entities are hard removed. Default: false.
config.annihilationblade.ultimate_invinc: Method-level invulnerability: when enabled, intercepts holder's hurt/die/actuallyHurt/kill/tickDeath at the bytecode level via Mixin. Creative mode, void, and other god-mods cannot kill the player. Default: false.
config.annihilationblade.ultimate_theseu: When enabled, the server checks whether the holder still exists in the world every tick; if hard-removed by any means, reconstructs the holder as a 'new existence' with the same UUID. Default: false.
Reflects damage to the attacker or projectile shooter. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.defense_enabled: Enables Loli Blade absolute defense and damage interception. Enabled by default.
Automatically restores full health and saturation after taking damage or triggering defense. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.grant_flight.to: Grants creative-style flight while holding Loli Blade. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.void_protection: Automatically rescues the holder to a safe altitude when falling into the void. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.slash_art_range: Loli Blade SA Area Execution Radius
config.annihilationblade.client_tooltips: Enable the custom Annihilation Blade tooltip renderer.
Enable the custom Infinity Stellaris tooltip renderer.
config.annihilationblade.enable_annihila: Enable the custom Annihilation Blade tooltip renderer.
config.annihilationblade.enable_infinity: Enable the custom Infinity Stellaris tooltip renderer.
config.annihilationblade.fx_renderer_ena: Draw skill effects with the dedicated renderer (magic circles, blade arcs, volumetric rifts, bloom). Falls back to a few vanilla particles when disabled or if the renderer fails.
config.annihilationblade.fx_volumetric_e: Enable full-screen ray-marched passes: shattered-space refraction, void shards, black-hole lensing and volumetric rift glow. Disable on low-end GPUs for higher FPS.
config.annihilationblade.fx_volumetric_q: 1 = Low (12 steps, half resolution), 2 = Medium (22 steps, half resolution), 3 = High (32 steps, full resolution).
config.annihilationblade.fx_bloom_enable: Bloom is applied to the effects only, so the rest of the scene is not washed out.
config.annihilationblade.fx_bloom_streng: Bloom intensity multiplier for effects. Default: 1.0.
config.annihilationblade.fx_screen_shake: Multiplier for all of this mod's screen shakes (including the Nightfall Dragon shake). 0 disables it.
Maximum per-axis camera rotation from all of this mod's screen shakes combined (including the Nightfall Dragon shake), default 6°. Set to 0 to disable shaking entirely.
config.annihilationblade.fx_screen_flash: Screen flash intensity for skills. 0 disables it. Lower it if you are sensitive to flashing lights.
config.annihilationblade.fx_chromatic_ab: Chromatic aberration (RGB split) multiplier. 0 disables it.
config.annihilationblade.fx_with_shader_: Keep the renderer enabled when an Iris/Oculus shader pack is active (drawn after the shader pack composite). Disable it if you see glitches; vanilla particles are used instead.
config.annihilationblade.loli_max_target: Loli Blade maximum area attack targets
config.annihilationblade.annihilation_bl: Whether to enable the 'Severed Space: Instant Prison Flash' SE. Enabled by default.

Whether to enable the 'World Rift: Causal Scar' Kamui spatial-warp execution (standalone single-chain hops when Severed Space is disabled, plus linked corpse-twisting after Severed Space finishes). Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.dankong_linkage: When Severed Space is enabled and executes targets, automatically trigger World Rift right after its sheathing slice to twist all severed remains into black singularities. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.annihilation_bl: Whether to enable the 'Terminus Echo: Causal Reprisal' defensive counter SE (devours incoming attacks/projectiles and sends a black-gold afterimage to trace and execute the attacker). Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.require_held.to: When enabled, Causal Reprisal only triggers while a blade with Terminus Echo is held in the main hand or offhand; when disabled, keeping it anywhere in your inventory still triggers counter-execution. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.intercept_proje: When enabled, hostile arrows, fireballs, tridents, and other projectiles hitting the deflection mirror are immediately devoured and traced back to their shooter. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.deflect_environ: Whether absorbing source-less environmental damage (lava, fire, fall, etc.) displays a lightweight deflection mirror ripple. Disabled by default to avoid lava spam.
config.annihilationblade.annihilation_bl: Whether to enable the 'Void Dominion: All-Things Obliteration' SE (triggered by pressing Left + Right click together). Enabled by default.

Whether to enable the 'Causality Collapse: Spacetime Rift' SE (World Rift aftermath scars, vanilla Shift lock-on remote snipes, free air slashes, continuous gravitational suction, and core spatial crushing). Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.world_rift_link: After World Rift swallows slain targets into black singularities (both Severed Space group linkage and standalone single-chain hops), automatically leave a lingering World-Rift-kin swirling spacetime rift scar at each enemy's exact position. Enabled by default.
When enabled, aftermath rift scars left by World Rift linkage also pull and crush nearby hostile mobs (automatically deferring execution while a single-chain hop is active). When disabled, only standalone slash rifts pull and crush. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.devour_executio: When enabled, hostile mobs pulled into a spacetime rift's core are silently executed and torn into the slit; when disabled, rifts only pull and group mobs without dealing lethal damage. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.lock_on_linkage: When enabled, holding Shift to lock onto a distant mob with vanilla SlashBlade lock-on (which also pauses Severed Space) and right-clicking immediately carves a spacetime rift right across that target; without lock-on, swings fall back to free crosshair smart lock-on and then smart surface/air slashing. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.annihilation_bl: Whether to enable the 'Phantom Judgement: Thousand-Shard Stream' SE. Enabled by default.
config.annihilationblade.infinity_stella: Enable SE Entropy Dissolution (works when transplanted onto any SlashBlade).
Enable SE Cosmic String Cut (mid/long-range two-beat string web applying entropy marks).
Enable SE Gamma Thunderburst (orbital cannon warning + sustained beam applying entropy marks).
Enable SE Curvature Rupture (toggle domain suppression and metric collapse via key I).
[Dangerous legacy option, default OFF] Keeps mobs in NoAI after Curvature Rupture releases them (former C-key behavior).
Infinity Stellaris - SA Vacuum Decay Collapse
Enable SA Vacuum Decay Collapse (works when transplanted onto any SlashBlade).
Whether final reckoning clears target drops and XP (default false to preserve loot and quest items).
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_quali: Controls black hole geodesic steps, heavy pass scale, world capture resolution, and god-ray steps.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_world: Captures surrounding terrain into a 6-face atlas so the black hole bends real world geometry.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_anamo: Adds horizontal anamorphic lens streaks on extreme bright bursts.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_impac: Defaults to photosensitive-safe mode (edges/halftone without rapid polarity flips); Full mode enables polarity inversion.
Scales 12fps impact frame blend intensity (0.0 = off, 1.0 = full).
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_full_: Indicates acknowledgement of the photosensitive warning for Full polarity-inversion impact frames.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_flash: Briefly retains a soft-focus retinal afterimage after major bursts.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_audio: Enables the 5-tick absolute silence beat right before the SA singularity detonation.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_sa_ci: Plays a 2.4s procedural star-leap cut-in for the caster only (skippable, never affects observers).
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_blade: Renders 16-layer procedural tangent-space cosmic parallax on the blade luminous layer.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_aura_: Enables the client-only armillary rings and floating polestar wings while holding Infinity Stellaris.
Adjusts overall opacity of the armillary rings and polestar wings (0.0 to 1.0).
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_gpu_a: Automatically steps down one quality tier for 5s when GPU frame time exceeds budget.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_disab: Skips heavy raymarched offscreen passes while Iris/Oculus shaders are active, keeping lightweight geometry visuals.
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_iris_: Defers first-person hand & blade rendering until after Stellaris full-screen post-processing while Iris/Oculus shaders are active, preventing distortion or impact frames from smearing the hand (zero overhead in vanilla).
config.annihilationblade.stellaris_relie: Enables GPU pre-baked 2048²/4096² celestial distance fields and 3D tube-marched relief arrays with true front/back depth occlusion across beams, black holes, and instanced particles.
config.annihilationblade.blade_fullbrigh: Enables fullbright vision while carrying Annihilation Blade or Infinity Stellaris; automatically yields during Stellaris night-steal/dimming setpieces and shader packs to preserve deep-space contrast.
message.annihilationblade.stellaris.impa: §b[Stellaris Engine] §eFull impact frames contain high-frequency polarity inversions (photosensitivity risk) and fell back to Safe mode. Check 'Full Impact Warning Acknowledged' in client config to unlock Full mode.
